Critically analyze the benefits and limitations of distributed
and decentralized computing in Web 3.0.

Cloud Computing. State the effective measures to overcome
the aforementioned problems in cloud environment.
In the realm of Virtualization at Server in Cloud Computing,
differentiate between Logical Partitioning and Physical
Partitioning with suitable illustrations.
Quantitatively differentiate between Virtualization at Server,
at Network and at Desktop and Application in Cloud
Computing paradigm. Explain with suitable illustrations.

from clients’ perspective. Simultaneously highlight the Cloud
Security Design Principles from organizations’ perspective.

Testing and Cloud Testing with suitable real-world examples.

their e-Healthcare Management System.

between the cloud service provider and its client. Enlist the
